<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Swipe Souvenir](/Feats.aspx?ID=4959) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rogue" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=687" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 174

**Requirements**
You’re grabbed or restrained by a creature

</column>

---

When you wriggle free from an enemy’s grasp, you take something of theirs with you. You attempt to Escape from being grabbed or restrained by a creature. If you succeed, you can also attempt to Steal from the creature, even if the creature is in combat.
name: Swipe Souvenir
requirement: You’re grabbed or restrained by a creature
